notes: Neutron star cooling constraint on U(1)_B-L gauge boson from rapid cooling of Cas A. Conservative bound e' < 5e-13 for m_gamma' < Tc(n3P2) = O(0.1) MeV (Eq. 40), valid for masses below ~0.1 MeV = 1e5 eV. The paper also derives a dark photon bound eps*m_gamma' < 1.5e-8 MeV (Cas A) and 3e-9 MeV (NS1987A), but the coupling for the dark photon scenario is the product eps*m_gamma' rather than a mass-independent chi, making a clean chi-vs-mass extraction ambiguous. Chose to report the B-L bound since it is directly the dimensionless coupling e' = g_BL. Range spanned as flat horizontal line from ~keV down to O(0.1 MeV).
